description: List Cloudflare zones, optionally filtered by name and status.

name.description: Optional zone name (domain) to filter zones by.

status.description: Optional zone status to filter zones by (e.g. 'active').

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of zone objects (id, name, status, paused, type, development_mode, plan, created_on, modified_on); on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single Cloudflare zone by its id.

zone_id.description: The unique id of the zone.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the zone object; on failure (zone not found), output contains an error message.

description: List DNS records for a zone, optionally filtered by type and name.

zone_id.description: The unique id of the zone.

type.description: Optional DNS record type to filter by (e.g. 'A', 'CNAME', 'MX').

name.description: Optional record name to filter by.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of DNS record objects; on failure (zone not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single DNS record within a zone by its id.

zone_id.description: The unique id of the zone.

record_id.description: The unique id of the DNS record.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the DNS record object; on failure (zone or record not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new DNS record within a zone.

zone_id.description: The unique id of the zone the record belongs to.

content.description: The record content (e.g. IP address or target).

ttl.description: Time to live in seconds; 1 means automatic (default 1).

proxied.description: Whether the record is proxied through Cloudflare (default false).

priority.description: Record priority, used for MX/SRV records (default 0).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created DNS record object; on failure (zone not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing DNS record within a zone.

zone_id.description: The unique id of the zone.

record_id.description: The unique id of the DNS record to update.

ttl.description: Optional new time to live in seconds.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated DNS record object; on failure (zone or record not found), output contains an error message.

description: Delete a DNS record within a zone by its id.

zone_id.description: The unique id of the zone.

record_id.description: The unique id of the DNS record to delete.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains the deleted record id; on failure (zone or record not found), output contains an error message.

description: List firewall rules for a zone, sorted by priority.

zone_id.description: The unique id of the zone.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of firewall rule objects sorted by priority; on failure (zone not found), output contains an error message.
